name: Bubble Cursor
summary: An adaptive cursor expands until it encloses the nearest available target.
howItWorks: Move the cursor near a target; the selection region adapts to isolate it.
advantages: Dense scenes with many small selectable objects.
limitations: Can feel unpredictable when target positions change quickly.
